:::{#exm-linearity-finite-sum}
#### Expected total of five dice

Let $X_1, \ldots, X_5$ be the outcomes of five rolls of a fair die.
Each roll has
[expectation](expectation.qmd#def-expectation)
$\E{X_i} = `r mean(1:6)`$.
Applying @lem-linearity-finite-sum with every $a_i = 1$ gives
the expected total:

$$
\ba
\E{\sum_{i=1}^5 X_i}
&= \sum_{i=1}^5 \E{X_i}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation for finite sums)} \\
&= 5 \cd `r mean(1:6)`
&& \text{(each roll has expectation } `r mean(1:6)` \text{)} \\
&= `r 5 * mean(1:6)`
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$

:::
